description: Issue #149, the subtler half of the same refusal: `add: ["docs/module-reference.md"]` carries no glob, yet it grants a FIXED path that contains nothing derived from the declaration — the shape ADR §15.2 records as deliberately left out of this first cut. Invariant 1 is enforced structurally: every `add` template must bind at least one placeholder from its `when`, so a rule that is not a function of a declared path cannot be written. Also refused at load (load_error, exit 6).
